svg.title: Two loops for self-programmable hardware
svg.desc: An active sensor pipeline supplies application results and telemetry. A slower agent proposes a design, tools compile it, and independent validation decides whether to accept it. A deployment controller installs compatible accepted candidates and can restore a known-good image.
